COMPLETE COURSE SYLLABUS

ADMINISTRATIVE LAW AND LAW ON PUBLIC OFFICERS

University Of Negros Occidental-Recoletos
Atty. Keinth Laña Horario, CPA · 1st Semester, A.Y. 2026-2027

Class policies

  1. Attendance shall be checked at the start of every session; students are expected to be punctual and prepared to recite on the assigned cases and topics.
  2. Only the latest editions of the Constitution, the Administrative Code, and the assigned casebooks/reviewers may be used during recitation and examinations.
  3. Cross-recitation and the Socratic method shall be used; students must be ready to answer questions on any case in the syllabus for the week.
  4. No special examinations shall be given except for the most meritorious reasons, subject to the approval of the professor and the School of Law.
  5. Use of Cellphone is STRICTLY PROHIBITED.

Grading system

Grading table 1
Midterm Exam40%
Final Exam60%
Final Grade100%
Grading table 2
Major Exam60%
Recitation30%
Attendance and Quiz10%
Final Grade100%

When called to recitation and absent will get 40 points, present and haven’t answer anything 60%.

Consultation

By appointment, before or after class, or through the professor's official email or School of Law consultation schedule.
